title: Centrifugal Effect Model
text: Implement mathematical representation of centrifugal effect for planetary gravity, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Planet model} sets Planetary model; {Planetary rotational rate (rad/sec)} sets the planetary rotational rate 7.2921150e-05 and {Input planetary rotation rate} sets the planetary rotation rate port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Planet model
params.values: Planetary model Earth (default) | Venus | Mercury | Moon | Mars | Jupiter | Saturn | Uranus | Neptune | Custom

params.name: Input planetary rotation rate
params.values: Planetary rotation rate port off (default) | on
